env_vars_required.name: DATABASE_URL
env_vars_required.description: SQLite connection string for Prisma. Format: file:<path-relative-to-schema.prisma>, e.g. file:./dev.db

env_vars_required.name: PORT
env_vars_required.description: Port the backend Express server listens on. Default: 3001

env_vars_required.name: APP_ENV
env_vars_required.description: Controls dev-only behavior such as verbose Prisma logging. Set to 'development' locally

env_vars_required.name: VITE_API_BASE_URL
env_vars_required.description: Base URL of the backend API used by the frontend api-client, e.g. http://localhost:3001

setup_notes: Copy backend/.env.example to backend/.env and frontend/.env.example to frontend/.env before running (Vite only reads .env from its own package root, hence two separate files)
Run 'npm run db-setup' in backend/ (prisma migrate dev --name init && prisma generate) before using db.js, to create the SQLite DB and generate the Prisma client
auth-middleware and pagination-helper were intentionally skipped per shared_decisions (no auth mechanism, no pagination strategy)
frontend/src/router/index.js lazily imports ../views/TaskListView.vue, which does not exist yet — will be created by screen implementation
errorHandler is wired into backend/src/index.js, registered after the ASDLC_ROUTES markers (Express requires error middleware registered last, after all routes)
